enemies.name: Filth
enemies.flavour_text: A fabric construct born from the farmers' fears of a poor harvest. They carry a crop-killing Blight, and pose a great risk to agricultural yields.

abilities.text: Causes Blight to the paddy when defeated
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

enemies.name: Expelled Filth
enemies.flavour_text: A fabric construct born from the farmers' fears of a failed harvest. They carry a wide range of crop-killing Blights, and pose a tremendous risk to agricultural yields.

abilities.text: Causes Blight to the paddy when defeated
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

enemies.name: Consumption
enemies.flavour_text: A fabric construct that contaminates plants, capable of spraying Blight from a distance. Even crops on agricultural plates are at risk.

abilities.text: When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal Arts damage

enemies.name: Banished Consumption
enemies.flavour_text: A fabric construct that corrodes plants, capable of spraying highly hazardous Blight from a distance. Even well-protected crops on agricultural plates are at risk.

abilities.text: When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal Arts damage

enemies.name: Scum
enemies.flavour_text: A large fabric construct that uses its huge mass and thick skin to run rampant across the paddies, detested by farmers.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked
Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

enemies.name: Accursed Scum
enemies.flavour_text: A gargantuan fabric construct that uses its huge mass and nigh-impenetrable skin to wreak havoc across the paddies, loathed by farmers.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked
Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

enemies.name: Blemish
enemies.flavour_text: A fabric construct that spreads Blight across a wide area. If left unchecked, once fertile farmland will become a hotbed of blight in less than half a day.

abilities.text: Absorbs shallow water to attack all allied melee units on the map, dealing splash damage in a cross
When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal additional Arts damage and causes Blight to the paddy

enemies.name: Renounced Blemish
enemies.flavour_text: A fabric construct that ruthlessly spreads Blight across a wide area. If left unchecked, once fertile farmland will instantly become a farmer's worst nightmare.

abilities.text: Absorbs shallow water to attack all allied melee units on the map, dealing splash damage in a cross
When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal additional Arts damage and causes Blight to the paddy

enemies.name: Miasma
enemies.flavour_text: Similar to a stockbeast in appearance, seemingly docile at first glance. But unlike other fabric constructs, they become aggressive towards people after absorbing the Blight in the soil and water, so exercise caution.

abilities.text: Rebirth
Regenerates itself on the spot when defeated, continuously absorbing any Blight it is in contact with and increasing DEF based on the amount absorbed; attacks now deal additional Arts damage

enemies.name: Basal Miasma
enemies.flavour_text: Similar to a stockbeast in appearance, seemingly docile at first glance. But unlike other fabric constructs, they become very aggressive towards people after absorbing the Blight in the soil and water, so exercise the utmost caution.

abilities.text: Rebirth
Regenerates itself on the spot when defeated, continuously absorbing any Blight it is in contact with and increasing DEF based on the amount absorbed; attacks now deal additional Arts damage

enemies.name: Fieldmus
enemies.flavour_text: The fieldmus is the farmer's sworn enemy, as well as a living page from the annals of Terra's agricultural history. They have adapted to modern farming techniques, and even Throttle Valves cannot escape their destructive tendencies.

abilities.text: Attacks surrounding Throttle Valves
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

enemies.name: Hard-Snouted Fieldmus
enemies.flavour_text: The fieldmus is the farmer's sworn enemy, as well as a living page from the annals of Terra's agricultural history. They have fully adapted to modern farming techniques, and even the most advanced Throttle Valves cannot escape their destructive tendencies.

abilities.text: Attacks surrounding Throttle Valves
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

enemies.name: Fieldmus Bruiser
enemies.flavour_text: The more bountiful the harvest, the fatter the fieldmus. When these creatures grow four-packs, even the Tianshis sigh—for they destroy Throttle Valves with frightening efficiency.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over

enemies.name: Fieldmus Ravager
enemies.flavour_text: The more bountiful the harvest, the fatter the fieldmus. When these creatures grow eight-packs, even the Tianshis rub their aching brows—for they can do away with a Throttle Valve in the blink of an eye.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over

enemies.name: Fieldmus Flying Thief
enemies.flavour_text: The thing with fieldmus is that not only do they ruin farm equipment, they also take the loose parts back to their lairs. Who knows, maybe they'll be able to build a nomadic city one day.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over
When defeated, grants a deployable unit

enemies.name: Fieldmus Heistmaster
enemies.flavour_text: The thing with fieldmus is that not only do they dismantle farm equipment, they also leave no loose parts behind. Who knows, maybe they'll be able to build a nomadic city one day.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over
When defeated, grants a deployable unit

enemies.name: Sky Pole - Jia
enemies.flavour_text: Structural pillar-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Jia. Capable of monitoring soil conditions, water source quality, and pest and Blight status in real time; during emergency situations, can release the corresponding Sky Pole Model Yi.

abilities.text: Starts battle as a friendly unit, monitors the paddy's Blight level
Wakes up when the Blight level in the current paddy exceeds a certain threshold
Gradually loses HP. For every certain percentage of HP lost, releases a certain number of Sky Pole - Yi

enemies.name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Jia
enemies.flavour_text: Structural pillar-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Jia. Originally capable of monitoring soil conditions, water source quality, and pest and Blight status in real time; during emergency situations, can release the corresponding Sky Pole Model Yi. However, it has now gone out of control.

abilities.text: Starts battle as a friendly unit, monitors the paddy's Blight level
Wakes up when the Blight level in the current paddy exceeds a certain threshold
Gradually loses HP. For every certain percentage of HP lost, releases a certain number of Out of Control Sky Pole - Yi

enemies.name: Sky Pole - Yi
enemies.flavour_text: UAV-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Yi. Capable of completing tasks within the signal range of Model Jia, such as collecting crop samples, eliminating pests, spraying pesticides, and driving away trespassing beasts.

abilities.text: Latches onto the first unit within range and relentlessly attacks until the target is defeated

enemies.name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Yi
enemies.flavour_text: UAV-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Yi. Originally capable of completing tasks within the signal range of Model Jia, such as collecting crop samples, eliminating pests, spraying pesticides, and driving away trespassing beasts. However, it has now gone out of control.

abilities.text: Latches onto the first unit within range and relentlessly attacks until the target is defeated

enemies.name: 'Slumbering of Sui'
enemies.flavour_text: Born from the heart of an awakened Feranmut. A thousand years twisted into shadow. The executors of Sui are never alone, for fear is always by their side; to wait in the boundless chaos, or thread the needle in search for a shred of enlightenment?

abilities.text: Chaos
Molts after taking a certain amount of damage, causing Blight to the paddies it is on, reducing ATK, DEF, RES, and Weight, while increasing Movement Speed
When HP drops to 0 for the first time, melts into the water and continuously summons enemies; enters the Enlightened State when reborn
Enlightened
Changes attributes, attacks now deal 2 strikes of Physical damage, and becomes immune to most control effects
Marks all allied units that have attacked 'Slumbering of Sui'; when a marked unit leaves the field, causes extremely high level of Blight to the tiles where 'Slumbering of Sui' is on

[As Needlework] When the Blight level of a paddy at this unit's location exceeds a certain threshold, 'Slumbering of Sui' will continuously absorb and condense Blight into a spear that deals a large amount of Arts damage, prioritizing marked Operators
'Slumbering of Sui' has reduced DEF, RES, and Movement Speed when it is on paddies unaffected by Blight, or when scoured with unpolluted water.
